Description: Extensive open-access repository for preprints (>2 million) in physics, mathematics, computer science, biology, finance, and statistics. A good complement to OpenAlex and PubMed Central.
License: ✅ Freely accessible
Content & Formats: REST API (Atom 1.0 XML) | Full-text links (PDF) with structured metadata: Title, Author, Abstract, Subject category, ArXiv ID
Limitations: No hard rate limit. Recommended: ~3 sec between requests | Max 30,000 results per query | Results returned in slices up to 2,000 | Queries with >1,000 results should be refined | No PDF bulk download via API (only individual links)
Documentation: REST API User Manual | ArXiv API Quick Reference
How to Request Access: No registration or API key required. Use responsibly per Terms of Use.

Description: Publisher-supplied metadata including full-text URLs where available. Multiple APIs for querying, filtering, sorting, real-time updates, TDM license screening, and full-text links.
License: ✅ Freely accessible | ⚠️ License required for Metadata Plus
Content & Formats: REST API (JSON) for selective queries | XML API (DOI and metadata queries) | Event Data API (events referencing DOIs in patents, social media, Wikipedia) | Metadata dumps (complete corpus as annual JSONL packages)
Limitations: No explicit rate limits; responsible use expected. Not intended for bulk downloading.
Documentation: REST API | OpenAPI/Swagger | GitHub Quickstart | XML API | Dumps | Event Data API
How to Request Access: No registration or API key required.

Description: >100,000 peer-reviewed OA books from more than 600 publishers. Full texts hosted in OA publisher repositories or on OAPEN.
License: ✅ Freely accessible | Metadata and OA full texts openly reusable
Content & Formats: REST API (JSON) for querying metadata and associated files (PDF, EPUB, and other formats) | Search fields follow Dublin Core conventions (e.g., dc.title, dc.creator, handle)
Limitations: No explicit rate limits; responsible use expected.
Documentation: REST API | API Documentation | OAPEN
How to Request Access: No registration or API key required.

Description: >20,000 quality-assured Open Access journals; >10 million articles with links to full texts.
License: ✅ Freely accessible | Metadata openly reusable | No full texts included
Content & Formats: REST API (JSON) for metadata GET requests | Article and journal metadata (title, ISSN/EISSN, license, full-text URL, abstract, keywords, publisher) | Elasticsearch-based query syntax (e.g., bibjson.journal.title) | Use cases: OA corpus creation, TDM license screening, OA landscape analysis
Limitations: No explicit rate limits; responsible use expected.
Documentation: DOAJ API Live Documentation | DOAJ Blog (API News)
How to Request Access: No registration or API key required. API keys issued only to publishers who deposit metadata with DOAJ.

Description: >33 million articles, preprints, and abstracts in the biomedical/life sciences domain, including 10.2 million full texts and >6.5 million OA articles. Sources: PubMed/Medline, Agricola, Chinese Biological Abstracts, European Patent Office, NICE, NHS Evidence.
License: ✅ Freely accessible | ⚠️ Full-text access determined by article license status
Content & Formats: RESTful API (XML/JSON/DC) | SOAP API (XML) | Queryable data: annotations/extracted entities (gene, protein, chemical, disease, organism, GO terms, accession numbers), citations, references, database links, supplementary files, book HTML/XML/PDF links
Limitations: No explicit rate limits; responsible use expected. Bulk download provided via FTP.
Documentation: EBI Search (Web, RESTful API, Webinar) | SOAP Web Service Guide | Europe PMC Annotations API
How to Request Access: No registration or API key required.

Description: Access to rich cultural heritage data (images, text, audio, video, 3D objects) from thousands of institutions across Europe. Includes search, retrieval, and thumbnail APIs.
License: ⚠️ API key required | Data under various open licenses (CC BY
Content & Formats: CC0
Limitations: etc.)
Documentation: REST API (JSON, JSON-LD) | Search API | Record API | Thumbnail API | IIIF Manifest API
How to Request Access: 10,000 API calls/day (free tier)
column11: API key required. Register at https://pro.europeana.eu/page/get-api

Description: Text mining content including journals, OA eBooks, OCR data (Reveal Digital open collections), pamphlets, and research reports. Images and media excluded.
License: ✅ Non-commercial research
Content & Formats: teaching
Limitations: and learning | ❌ Training third-party AI models not permitted
Documentation: No traditional real-time API | Metadata: JSONL dump (JSTOR Bibliographic Metadata File) | Full-text: custom datasets on demand | Data filterable using Python
How to Request Access: Maximum dataset size: 1.5 million items
Last Sighted: Working with JSTOR Bibliographic Metadata | Working with JSTOR Full-Text Datasets
column11: Submit a Data Set Request via JSTOR account. All requests must be approved. See JSTOR Text Analysis: Getting Started.

Description: Programmatic access to query and publish biodiversity occurrence data on GBIF.org. Enables advanced queries, workflow integration, script automation, and data embedding.
License: ✅ Freely accessible | Data licensing varies per dataset; GBIF terms apply
Content & Formats: REST API (JSON) | Key endpoints: Registry, Species, Occurrence, Maps (v2), Literature, Validator, Vocabularies, Analytics
Limitations: HTTP 429 during high server load. For scripts taking >15 min, request a download instead. No guaranteed query rate. Recommended: set HTTP User-Agent to URL or email address.
Documentation: GBIF OpenAPI Reference | GBIF Technical Documentation
How to Request Access: Most queries: no authentication | POST/PUT/DELETE: GBIF account required (HTTP Basic Auth)

Description: Search and retrieve book volume metadata, manage personal bookshelves, retrieve reviews and reading positions. Embed Google Books features into websites and apps.
License: Content: CC BY 4.0 | Code samples: Apache 2.0 | ⚠️ API key required for public data
Content & Formats: REST API (JSON) | Endpoints: volumes (list/retrieve), bookshelves (list/retrieve/insert/update/delete) | Example: GET https://www.googleapis.com/books/v1/volumes?q=quilting
Limitations: Rate limits not specified in documentation.
Documentation: Google Books API Documentation | Google API Console
How to Request Access: API key required for public data (via Google API Console) | OAuth 2.0 required for private library operations

Description: Historical newspaper and radio archive corpus from multiple European collections, enriched with machine learning (NER, text reuse, topic models). Covers articles, entities, media sources, collections, and text reuse clusters. Research project funded by Swiss and Luxembourg research foundations.
License: Python library: GNU AGPL v3 | Data access: registration required via Impresso Datalab | ❌ Commercial use not permitted without agreement
Content & Formats: REST API (JSON) | Python client library (pip install impresso) | Resources: Search (articles by term/date/language/entity/topic) | Entities (persons, locations; Wikidata-linked) | Media Sources (newspapers/publications) | Collections (user-curated) | Text Reuse (clusters and passages) | NER/NEL tools | Results exportable as pandas DataFrame
Limitations: Rate limits not publicly specified | Access restricted to registered users | Token-based authentication (stored in ~/.impresso_py.yml)
Documentation: Impresso Datalab | Python Library Documentation (impresso-py) | Swagger API Docs | GitHub: impresso/impresso-py
How to Request Access: Register at https://impresso-project.ch/datalab/ to obtain an access token. Authenticate via impresso.connect() in the Python library.

API Name: Linked Data Service with DNB SPARQL Service
Endpoint: SRU: https://services.dnb.de/sru/dnb | OAI-PMH: https://services.dnb.de/oai/repository | SPARQL (BETA): https://data.dnb.de/sparql
Description: German National Library national bibliographic data and GND authority data in RDF format, contributing to the global semantic web.
License: CC BY 4.0
Content & Formats: RDF serializations: Turtle, RDF/XML, JSON-LD (UTF-8 NFD) | SRU interface (standard search) | OAI-PMH interface (metadata harvesting) | DNB SPARQL Service BETA (available since September 2025) | Data Shop (RDF downloads)
Limitations: Rate limits not specified; contact metadatendienste@dnb.de
Documentation: DNB LDS Documentation | Business Model | SPARQL Service
How to Request Access: No authentication specified for read access. Contact: metadatendienste@dnb.de

Description: Search OSM data by name and address; reverse geocoding (generate addresses from coordinates); limited feature-type search (e.g., pubs, hotels, churches).
License: Open source (GNU GPL) | OSM data under ODbL
Content & Formats: REST API | Output formats: JSON, XML, GeoJSON, GeocodeJSON | Endpoints: /search, /reverse, /lookup, /status, /details
Limitations: Max 1 request/sec on public instance (https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/). No bulk geocoding. Self-hosting recommended for heavy use.
Documentation: Nominatim API Documentation | Usage Policy
How to Request Access: No API key required. Must comply with Nominatim Usage Policy. Self-hosting encouraged for high-volume use.

Description: Open-source citation database with >450 million scholarly works. Open alternative to Scopus/Web of Science. Sources: Crossref, DOAJ, Microsoft Academic Graph, ORCID, Unpaywall, PubMed, PubMed Central, ROR. Covers grey literature, preprints, non-English research.
License: ✅ Freely accessible (CC0) | ❌ Premium institution-level API access is fee-based
Content & Formats: REST API (JSON) | Endpoints: works, authors, sources, institutions, topics, publishers, funders | Complex filters supported (e.g., indexed by DOAJ) | Snapshots (JSONL): full database, updated monthly | Content API: PDF full texts (100 credits/PDF), TEI XML, Markdown (planned)
Limitations: 100 credits/24h without API key | 100,000 credits/24h with free API key | Max 100 queries/sec per user | Single entity = 1 credit; list of entities = 10 credits | Bulk PDF downloads require Enterprise credits
Documentation: OpenAlex Web Interface | OpenAlex API Reference | Comparison with other scholarly data sources | Pricing and Rate Limits | Tutorials | Blog
How to Request Access: Free API key required. See: https://docs.openalex.org/how-to-use-the-api/api-overview

Description: Harmonized parliamentary data from 74 national, cantonal and municipal parliaments across 46 cities, 26 cantons, and 2 countries (Switzerland and Liechtenstein). Covers motions, votes, members, and sessions.
License: ✅ Open data (opendata.ch)
Content & Formats: REST API (JSON) | Data: parliamentary motions, votes, members, sessions | Coverage: national, cantonal, and municipal parliaments in CH/LI
Limitations: Rate limits not specified; contact opendata.ch
Documentation: opendata.ch announcement | Project documentation
How to Request Access: Contact opendata.ch for access; API may still be in testing phase (as of August 2025)

Description: Public API for non-member organizations to connect to the ORCID registry via machine-to-machine communications. Supports OAuth sign-in, ORCID iD collection, public record retrieval, and registry search.
License: ORCID Public APIs Terms of Service
Content & Formats: RESTful API | Formats: XML and JSON | Endpoints: OAuth sign-in, public data retrieval, registry search, ORCID iD validation
Limitations: Rate limits not specified in documentation.
Documentation: ORCID Public API Documentation | ORCID API Tutorial
How to Request Access: Register application via ORCID Developer Tools (email verification required). Test on sandbox (sandbox.orcid.org) before production.

Description: Read-only database API for querying OpenStreetMap data. Query by location, object type, tags, proximity, or combinations. Optimized for data consumers needing specific map elements.
License: GNU AGPL v3 | OSM data under CC BY-SA 2.0
Content & Formats: Query languages: Overpass QL, XML | Output formats: JSON, XML, CSV, GeoJSON, GPX
Limitations: <10,000 queries/day and <1 GB/day recommended on public instances. Use a local instance for heavy workloads.
Documentation: OSM Wiki: Overpass API | Overpass Turbo (interactive) | Overpass API Documentation
How to Request Access: No API key required for public instances.

Description: Full-text access to biomedical literature. Collections: PMC Open Access (full texts), Author Manuscript, Historical OCR (18th-20th century), LitArch Open Access.
License: ✅ Freely accessible | CC licensing including commercial use | ⚠️ Full-text and TDM permissions determined by article license status
Content & Formats: Full-text formats: JSON, JATS-XML, TXT, BioC, PDF, media files | API services: PMC Cloud Service, PMC OAI-PMH, PMC FTP, E-Utilities, BioC API
Limitations: Avoid multiple simultaneous queries. Bulk access must use FTP or Cloud Service; no API bulk download.
Documentation: NCBI Developers Overview | E-Utilities Guide | BioC API Documentation | PMC FTP Service
How to Request Access: No API key required, but NCBI requires clients to provide a tool name and email address.

Description: REST API for academic literature. Academic Graph API: papers, authors, citations, venues, SPECTER2 embeddings. Recommendations API: similar papers. Datasets API: bulk downloads for local storage.
License: ✅ Freely accessible (no CC license) | ⚠️ API usage governed by own license agreement
Content & Formats: REST API (JSON) | Academic Graph API | Recommendations API | Datasets API (bulk downloads)
Limitations: Max 500 paper IDs per batch | Max 10 MB per response | Max 9,999 citations per call | Less restrictive with an API key (see documentation)
Documentation: Semantic Scholar API Documentation | Python Client Library | API Tutorial
How to Request Access: No API key required, but recommended. Individual license agreement required for use.

Description: DOI-based OA metadata API. Returns OA status (gold/green/hybrid/bronze/closed), license links, best_oa_location, and full-text URLs. Also supports title search.
License: ✅ Freely accessible
Content & Formats: REST API (JSON) | DOI-based lookup | Title search (max 50 results/page) | Data dumps available for large-scale projects
Limitations: <100,000 calls/24 hours | Title search: max 50 results/page | Large-scale projects: use data dumps
Documentation: API Documentation | Unpaywall Support Portal | How to use the title search API | How Unpaywall is transforming Open Science
How to Request Access: No API key required. Requests must include an email address as URL parameter (e.g., ?email=you@example.com).

Description: Virtual International Authority File: linked authority data from national libraries worldwide. Virtually combines multiple LAM (Library, Archives, Museum) name authority files into a single service.
License: ODC Attribution License (ODC-By) | Attribution required
Content & Formats: JSON, XML, RDF | URI-based access with HTTP content negotiation | Example: https://viaf.org/viaf/49224511 | Data files available for bulk download
Limitations: Rate limits not specified. Note: bulk data files last updated August 2024 (updates paused for security improvements).
Documentation: OCLC Developer Portal (requires JavaScript) | VIAF Data Downloads
How to Request Access: No API key required for public URI-based access. OCLC account may be required for full developer portal.

Description: SPARQL query service for querying structured linked data in Wikidata. Powers the Wikidata Query Service web interface.
License: CC0 (public domain)
Content & Formats: SPARQL 1.1 | Output formats: JSON, XML, CSV, TSV, Turtle, N-Triples, JSON-LD | Interactive: https://query.wikidata.org/
Limitations: 60-second query timeout | Max 5 concurrent queries per IP | No bulk download via SPARQL (use Wikidata dumps instead)
Documentation: Wikidata SPARQL Query Service | SPARQL Tutorial | MediaWiki User Manual
How to Request Access: No API key required.

Description: Programmatic access to Switzerland's national open data catalog, built on the CKAN platform. Search datasets, retrieve metadata, manage resources.
License: Datasets under various open licenses | CKAN platform (open source)
Content & Formats: REST API (JSON) | CKAN Action API | Key endpoints: package_search, package_show, organization_list, group_list, status_show | Response: JSON with help, success, result fields
Limitations: Rate limits not specified.
Documentation: opendata.swiss API Handbook | CKAN API Documentation
How to Request Access: Read-only: no authentication required | Write operations (package_create, package_patch): API key required (available from user profile page in opendata.swiss backend)
